title: Grays turning into owls in close encounter cases
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Grays turning into owls in close encounter cases, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: cases where people say they saw um grays turn into owls

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher, says there are cases where people report seeing "grays", the small grey-skinned beings often described in alien encounter stories, turn into owls. He credits the idea to a writer named Mike Cleland and a work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would suggest these beings can change how they appear to the people who meet them.
